title: Act 1, Scene 1 — A Desert Place
paragraphs: FIRST WITCH. When will we three meet again? In thunder, lightning, or in rain?
SECOND WITCH. When the uproar is over, when the battle is lost and won.
THIRD WITCH. That will be before the sun sets.
FIRST WITCH. Where shall we meet?
THIRD WITCH. There, to meet Macbeth.
ALL. Fair is foul, and foul is fair: hover through the fog and filthy air.
